<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#87CEEB;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1E3A8A;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Turf gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="turfGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#7CFC00;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#32CD32;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Horse gradients - different colors -->
    <linearGradient id="horse1Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#CD853F;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#A0522D;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#8B4513;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="horse2Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFE4B5;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#FFDAB3;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F5C39B;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="horse3Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D3D3D3;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#A9A9A9;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#808080;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="horse4Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF69B4;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#DA70D6;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#DA70D6;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Jail silks gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="silks1Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF0000;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FF4500;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="silks2Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#0000FF;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1E90FF;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="silks3Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFF00;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#ADFF2F;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="silks4Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#8A2BE2;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#9370DB;stop-op-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Finish line gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="finishGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFD700;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#FFEC8B;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FFD700;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Grandstand gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="grandstandGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#8B4513;stop-opacity:1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#A0522D;stop-opacity:1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Cloud pattern -->
    <pattern id="cloudPattern" x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="15" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="30" r="12" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="30" cy="35" r="14" fill="white"/>
    </pattern>
    
    <!-- Dust cloud animation -->
    <animateTransformGroup id="dustAnim" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 20,5; 0,0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </animateTransformGroup>
    
    <!-- Flag wave animation -->
    <set id="flagStart" attributeName="transform" attributeType="CSS" to="rotate(0 5 5)"/>
    <animate id="flagAnim" attributeName="transform" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite"
      dur="1.5s" values="rotate(0 5 5); rotate(30 5 5); rotate(0 5 5)" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    
    <!-- Tote board number change -->
    <text id="toteText" x="600" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="48" fill="#FFD700">
      1
    </text>
    <animate attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="6s"
      values="580; 600; 580" calcMode="linear"/>
    
    <!-- Photo-finish flash -->
    <rect id="photoFlash" x="100" y="100" width="1000" height="600" fill="none" opacity="0"/>
    <animate attributeName="opacity" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="3s"
      values="0; 0.3; 0" calcMode="linear"/>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Background sky -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="1050" cy="100" r="60" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="1050" cy="100" r="45" fill="#FFA500"/>
  <!-- Sun rays -->
  <g transform="rotate(20 1050 100)">
    <line x1="1050" y1="40" x2="1050" y2="10" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="8"/>
    <line x1="1050" y1="40" x2="1130" y2="40" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="8"/>
    <line x1="1050" y1="40" x2="1070" y2="10" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="8"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="rotate(70 1050 100)">
    <line x1="1050" y1="40" x2="1090" y2="70" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="8"/>
    <line x1="1050" y1="40" x2="1130" y2="40" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="8"/>
    <line x1="1050" y1="40" x2="1050" y2="10" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="8"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Moving clouds -->
  <g id="clouds">
    <g>
      <path d="M20 150 Q40 130 Q60 150 Q80 170 Q100 150 Z" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
      <animate attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="20s"
        values="0; -100; 0" calcMode="linear"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(150, 80)">
      <path d="M30 120 Q50 100 Q70 120 Q90 140 Q110 120 Z" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
      <animate attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="25s"
        values="0; -120; 0" calcMode="linear"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(300, 120)">
      <path d="M10 160 Q30 140 Q50 160 Q70 180 Q90 160 Z" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
      <animate attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="30s"
        values="0; -150; 0" calcMode="linear"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Turf track area -->
  <g id="track">
    <!-- Main track area -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q500 450 Q900 500 L900 600 L100 600 Z" fill="url(#turfGrad)"/>
    
    <!-- Inner turf line -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q500 495 Q900 500" stroke="#32CD32" stroke-width="8" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Outer track rail -->
    <path d="M100 600 Q500 580 Q900 600" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="12" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    
    <!-- Inner rail -->
    <path d="M100 500 Q500 510 Q900 500" stroke="#228B22" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Finish line -->
    <g id="finishLine">
      <line x1="1050" y1="440" x2="1050" y2="560" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="20 10"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; -10 0; 0 0" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <!-- Finish post -->
      <rect x="1055" y="430" width="8" height="130" fill="#CD853F"/>
      <!-- Winning post ribbon -->
      <line x1="1050" y1="430" x2="1050" y2="400" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Tote board -->
    <g id="toteBoard" transform="translate(1080, 520)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="120" height="80" fill="url(#grandstandGrad)" rx="5"/>
      <rect x="5" y="5" width="110" height="70" fill="#2F4F4F"/>
      <!-- Numbers -->
      <text x="60" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="36" fill="#FFD700">POST</text>
      <animate attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="4s"
        values="1080; 1050; 1080" calcMode="linear"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Leaderboard -->
    <g id="leaderboard" transform="translate(200, 460)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="200" height="60" fill="url(#grandstandGrad)" rx="3"/>
      <text x="50" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFD700">1st</text>
      <text x="120" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFD700">2nd</text>
      <text x="170" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFD700">3rd</text>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Grass beyond rail -->
  <g id="grass">
    <path d="M100 600 Q500 700 Q900 600 L900 800 L100 800 Z" fill="#228B22"/>
    <!-- Grass blades -->
    <g fill="#32CD32" opacity="0.6">
      <line x1="110" y1="600" x2="110" y2="590" transform="rotate(15 110 600)"/>
      <line x1="130" y1="610" x2="130" y2="595" transform="rotate(-10 130 610)"/>
      <line x1="150" y1="620" x2="150" y2="610" transform="rotate(20 150 620)"/>
      <line x1="170" y1="615" x2="170" y2="605" transform="rotate(-15 170 615)"/>
      <line x1="190" y1="625" x2="190" y2="615" transform="rotate(25 190 625)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 1 - Bay/ brown -->
  <g id="horse1" transform="translate(150, 470)">
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="80" ry="45" fill="url(#horse1Grad)"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <polygon points="-30,-15 -5,-25 10,-15 15 0" fill="url(#horse1Grad)"/>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <path d="M-15,-10 Q-25,-20 Q-35,-10 Q-25,0 Q-15,-10" fill="#8B0000" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M30,0 Q40,-20 Q50,0 Q40,20 Q30,0" fill="#8B0000" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g id="jockey1" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <!-- Saddle area -->
      <rect x="-25" y="-30" width="50" height="35" fill="url(#silks1Grad)"/>
      <!-- Jockey body -->
      <circle cx="-10" cy="-10" r="12" fill="#8B0000"/>
      <!-- Legs animation -->
      <g id="legs1">
        <line x1="-25" y1="0" x2="-40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 -25 0; 30 -25 0; 0 -25 0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 25 0; -30 25 0; 0 25 0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <!-- Numbers -->
      <text x="-20" y="-25" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#000">1</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Cap -->
    <polygon points="-15,-25 -5,-35 15,-25 5,-15" fill="url(#silks1Grad)"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 2 - Gray -->
  <g id="horse2" transform="translate(280, 460)">
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="80" ry="45" fill="url(#horse2Grad)"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <polygon points="-30,-15 -5,-25 10,-15 15 0" fill="url(#horse2Grad)"/>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <path d="M-15,-10 Q-20,-25 Q-30,-15 Q-20,-5 Q-15,-10" fill="#A9A9A9" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M30,0 Q40,-20 Q50,0 Q40,20 Q30,0" fill="#A9A9A9" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g id="jockey2" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="-25" y="-30" width="50" height="35" fill="url(#silks2Grad)"/>
      <circle cx="-10" cy="-10" r="12" fill="#A9A9A9"/>
      <!-- Legs -->
      <g id="legs2">
        <line x1="-25" y1="0" x2="-40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 -25 0; 30 -25 0; 0 -25 0" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 25 0; -30 25 0; 0 25 0" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <text x="-20" y="-25" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#000">2</text>
    </g>
    <polygon points="-15,-25 -5,-35 15,-25 5,-15" fill="url(#silks2Grad)"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 3 - White -->
  <g id="horse3" transform="translate(420, 480)">
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="80" ry="45" fill="url(#horse3Grad)"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <polygon points="-30,-15 -5,-25 10,-15 15 0" fill="url(#horse3Grad)"/>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <path d="M-15,-10 Q-25,-15 Q-35,-25 Q-25,-10 Q-15,-10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M30,0 Q40,-15 Q50,0 Q40,15 Q30,0" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g id="jockey3" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="-25" y="-30" width="50" height="35" fill="url(#silks3Grad)"/>
      <circle cx="-10" cy="-10" r="12" fill="#D3D3D3"/>
      <!-- Legs -->
      <g id="legs3">
        <line x1="-25" y1="0" x2="-40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 -25 0; 30 -25 0; 0 -25 0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 25 0; -30 25 0; 0 25 0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <text x="-20" y="-25" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#000">3</text>
    </g>
    <polygon points="-15,-25 -5,-35 15,-25 5,-15" fill="url(#silks3Grad)"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 4 - Purple -->
  <g id="horse4" transform="translate(550, 450)">
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="80" ry="45" fill="url(#horse4Grad)"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <polygon points="-30,-15 -5,-25 10,-15 15 0" fill="url(#horse4Grad)"/>
    <!-- Mane -->
    <path d="M-15,-10 Q-20,-30 Q-30,-20 Q-20,-10 Q-15,-10" fill="#DA70D6" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M30,0 Q40,-25 Q50,0 Q40,25 Q30,0" fill="#DA70D6" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- Jockey -->
    <g id="jockey4" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="-25" y="-30" width="50" height="35" fill="url(#silks4Grad)"/>
      <circle cx="-10" cy="-10" r="12" fill="#D6C1FF"/>
      <!-- Legs -->
      <g id="legs4">
        <line x1="-25" y1="0" x2="-40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 -25 0; 30 -25 0; 0 -25 0" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="40" y2="25" stroke="#000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 25 0; -30 25 0; 0 25 0" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <text x="-20" y="-25" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#000">4</text>
    </g>
    <polygon points="-15,-25 -5,-35 15,-25 5,-15" fill="url(#silks4Grad)"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Dust puffs from hooves -->
  <g id="dust" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite">
    <g id="dust1" transform="translate(80, 25)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="rgba(128,128,128,0.8)"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" dur="0.5s" values="1;0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="transform" type="translate" dur="0.5s" values="0,0; 10,5; 0,0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g id="dust2" transform="translate(35, 20)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="rgba(128,128,128,0.8)"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" dur="0.4s" values="1;0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g id="dust3" transform="translate(65, 30)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" fill="rgba(128,128,128,0.8)"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" dur="0.6s" values="1;0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Grandstand -->
  <g id="grandstand" transform="translate(800, 200)">
    <!-- Roof -->
    <polygon points="0,0 200,0 180,-20 20,-20" fill="#8B0000"/>
    <!-- Grandstand structure -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="200" height="300" fill="url(#grandstandGrad)" rx="5"/>
    <!-- Crowd -->
    <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8">
      <circle cx="30" cy="100" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="80" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="120" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="90" cy="90" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="110" cy="110" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="35" cy="60" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="85" cy="70" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="115" cy="50" r="3"/>
      <!-- More crowd rows -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="200" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="40" cy="180" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="60" cy="160" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="80" cy="140" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="100" cy="120" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="120" cy="100" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="180" cy="80" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="160" cy="120" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="140" cy="160" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="120" cy="200" r="3"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Flags -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 50)" id="flags">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="30" fill="red" opacity="0.8"/>
      <set id="flagSet1" attributeName="x" to="20"/>
      <animate id="flagAn1" attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite"
        dur="1.2s" values="0; 20; 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <rect x="40" y="0" width="20" height="30" fill="blue" opacity="0.8"/>
      <set id="flagSet2" attributeName="x" to="60"/>
      <animate id="flagAn2" attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite"
        dur="1.4s" values="0; 20; 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <rect x="80" y="0" width="20" height="30" fill="yellow" opacity="0.8"/>
      <set id="flagSet3" attributeName="x" to="100"/>
      <animate id="flagAn3" attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite"
        dur="1.6s" values="0; 20; 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <rect x="120" y="0" width="20" height="30" fill="green" opacity="0.8"/>
      <set id="flagSet4" attributeName="x" to="140"/>
      <animate id="flagAn4" attributeName="x" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite"
        dur="1.8s" values="0; 20; 0" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Scoreboard/Tote -->
    <text x="100" y="250" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="24" fill="#FFD700">ODDS</text>
    <text x="100" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="24" fill="#FFD700">10-1</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Photo-finish beam -->
  <g id="photoBeam" transform="translate(1050, 440)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-30" x2="0" y2="30" stroke="#FF0000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 5 0; 0 0" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Winning post -->
  <g id="winningPost" transform="translate(1060, 420)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="150" fill="#CD853F"/>
    <polygon points="10,0 20,75 10,150 0,75" fill="#CD853F"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="75" x2="20" y2="75" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Animation control - horse motion paths -->
  <!-- Horse 1 animateMotion -->
  <g id="horseMotion1">
    <animateMotion path="M150 470 L500 470 L900 470" begin="indefinite" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="12s">
      <animateTransform attributeName="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 2 animateMotion -->
  <g id="horseMotion2">
    <animateMotion path="M280 460 L600 460 L950 460" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="14s">
      <animateTransform attributeName="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="14s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 3 animateMotion -->
  <g id="horseMotion3">
    <animateMotion path="M420 480 L700 480 L1000 480" begin="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="16s">
      <animateTransform attributeName="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="16s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Horse 4 animateMotion -->
  <g id="horseMotion4">
    <animateMotion path="M550 450 L800 450 L1100 450" begin="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" dur="18s">
      <animateTransform attributeName="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </g>
</svg>
